title: Site Migration QA input

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Required. One per line. In List mode: the URLs to check (for example your old URLs). In Sitemap mode: a site address (its sitemap is found in robots.txt or at /sitemap.xml) or a sitemap URL. In Crawl mode: the page to start from. Only http and https; a missing https:// is added. Anything else (ftp:, mailto:, javascript:, text that is not a URL) is skipped, saved to INVALID_INPUTS and not charged. Duplicates are merged.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: list = check the given URLs (default). sitemap = expand the sitemap(s) of the given site first, then check every URL in them. crawl = follow links on the same site up to Max crawl depth.

maxPages.title: Max URLs
maxPages.description: Safety cap: stop after this many unique URLs. Default 1000, allowed 1 to 100000.

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: Crawl mode only. How many link levels to follow from the start page (0 = only the start page). Default 3, allowed 0 to 10.

checkExternal.title: Check external links
checkExternal.description: Crawl mode only. When on, links that point to other sites are checked too (they are checked, not crawled). Default: off.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many URLs are checked at the same time. Default 5, allowed 1 to 20. Requests to one host are also spaced out.

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobots.description: When on (default), URLs that robots.txt disallows for this Actor are not requested; they are returned with category robots_blocked and are not charged.

debugNetwork.title: Debug network
debugNetwork.description: Log connect details for failed requests (host, attempt, reason, error classes) to the run log. No headers, bodies, paths or query strings. Default: off.

description: Pick a mode and give the URLs. **List**: check exactly the URLs you give (the old URLs of a migration). **Sitemap**: read the site's sitemap and check every URL in it. **Crawl**: follow links on the same site and report the pages that link to broken URLs.
